query: update cloud_jobs set status=case when status in ('succeeded','failed','cancelled') then status else 'failed' end,reservation=case when reservation='open' then 'released' else reservation end,lease_expires_at=null,error_code=case when reservation='open' then 'expired' else error_code end,updated_at=now() where expires_at<=now() and (reservation='open' or status not in ('succeeded','failed','cancelled'))
